title: Capacity under an outward shift
statement: For every natural number $\ell$, every level $i\in\mathbb{N}$, and every assignment of finite words of optional Boolean values to the $\ell$ zones, suppose each word has length at most the capacity of its zone. After shifting the words outward at level $i$, every word still has length at most the capacity of its zone.

every assigned word has length at most its zone's capacity
